blueprint.description: 32x128 tiles. Ore/plate input: (16.5,0.5). Outputs: (9.5,127.5) and (23.5,127.5). No fuel belt. Iron/copper: 15/s per output; steel: 3/s per output from iron plate. 8.64 MW active furnace load, plus inserters/drain. Connect power before retiring fuel smelting.
